display_title: Maya: How to Survive in God's Paradise
description:
As I prepare for the Holy Maiden selection, serving the Maya God as usual, my childhood friend and savior in effect "Ian" starts acting suspiciously. The moment I begin to doubt him, I keep having dreams where I die and come back to life for various reasons. Along with Ian's strange behavior, disappearances and butchering incidents occur one after another, making everything seem increasingly suspicious. That night, I decided to follow Ian secretly. In the dark night, as I follow Ian into an alley. [A cold corpse's hand is illuminated at my feet.] Seeing the body Ian had killed, I thought that the reason I died multiple times in my dreams might be because of my longtime childhood friend, Ian.
